column1: Table 3.2: Distribution of median and mean income and tax, by age range and sex, tax year 2023 to 2024
This worksheet contains one table and some cells refer to notes which can be found on the accompanying notes worksheet.
Numbers of taxpayers are measured in thousands and amounts are measured in £. Totals may not sum due to rounding.
This table is based on UK taxpayers only and the source is the Survey of Personal Incomes (SPI) for the tax year 2023 to 2024. This table was last updated in April 2026
